question: Let △ABC ~ △QPR and frac{{{{ar}}( {{{Delta ABC}}} )}}{{{{ar}}( {{{Delta PQR}}} )}} = frac{{49}}{{144}}. If AB = 12 cm, BC = 9 cm and AC = 7 cm, then QR (in cm) is equal to:
solution:
Given:

frac{{{{ar}}( {{{Delta ABC}}} )}}{{{{ar}}( {{{Delta PQR}}} )}} = frac{{49}}{{144}}

AB = 12 cm

BC = 9 cm

AC = 7 cm

Concept:

According to the Similarity theorem, two triangles are said to be similar, if their sides are in equal proportion along with their corresponding angles. The area of the similar triangle would also be in proportion to the square of their similar sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a20ff3f5b161aab4cdf45df26e7f5d0678652bd2d9d4d9620680dd7ec8272017.png] 

Hence, if Δ ABC ~ Δ DEF

⇒ AB² over DE² = ar Δ ABC over ar Δ DEF and

⇒ ABover DE = ACover DF = BCover EF

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1d0829ddb6f5da09edb35981b9bdd9d8796ca2861de56e340509e6ce3b13773.png] 

△ABC ~ △QPR 

From the similarity theorem,

⇒ AC²over QR² = ar ABCover ar PQR 

Taking the square root of both the sides -

⇒ 7 over QR = 7over 12

⇒ QR = 12 cm

∴ The length of the QR is 12 cm.

3a:T
